cf920c6f.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 tikki) · Portion: 2 tikki + toppings ≈ 250 g
c: Boil, peel and mash potatoes dry; mix with crushed peas, starch, aromatics and spices.
Shape 20 patties 1.5 cm; shallow-fry 3–4 min each side until crisp.
Whisk yoghurt with sugar and a pinch of salt.
Plate 2 hot tikki on warm spiced chickpeas; spoon over yoghurt, tamarind and 15 g Hari Chutney (see its TTK).
Finish with onion, pomegranate, chaat masala, chilli and coriander.
Simmer all ingredients 15 min until syrupy.
Blend smooth; pass through a sieve; cool.
Cut fish into 4 cm fingers; marinate with paste, lemon and salt 20 min.
Whisk flours, ajwain, spices, egg and water to a thick batter.
Dip fish; fry at 175 °C 4–5 min until crisp (core 63 °C); drain.
Sprinkle chaat masala; serve with lemon wedges and mint chutney.
Blend herbs, chilli, ginger and lemon to a fine paste with 2 tbsp ice water.
Stir into yoghurt with cumin and salt; chill.
f2e65dfe.st: Cook to order. Marinated fish: 0–2 °C, 12 h.

c: Cut chicken 3 cm; marinate with paste, spices, lemon, yoghurt and salt 1 h; add egg, starch and rice flour.
Fry at 175 °C 5–6 min until crisp (core 75 °C); drain.
Toss in a hot wok with oil, curry leaves, slit chillies and garlic 30 s.
Coat in batter of flour, starch, paste, chilli, salt and water; fry at 180 °C 4 min; re-fry 1 min for crunch.
Stir-fry chopped garlic, ginger and chilli; add diced onion and pepper 1 min.
Add soy, ketchup, sriracha, vinegar, sugar and water; thicken with slaked starch.
Toss in hot cauliflower; spring onion; serve at once.
e3dd5437.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce). Vegan.

510f0ebb.yl: Yield: 10 portions (30 pcs) · Portion: 3 pcs ≈ 120 g
c: Blanch spinach and peas 1 min; refresh; squeeze dry; chop finely.
Mix with mashed potato, grated paneer, aromatics, spices and toasted gram flour.
Shape 30 patties; press a cashew in each.
Shallow-fry 2–3 min per side until crisp; serve with Hari Chutney.
510f0ebb.al: 7 Milk (paneer) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Vegetarian. Gluten-free. Contains 8 Nuts (cashew).

c: Urad dal 400 g dry → ≈ 850 g batter
Soak dal 4 h; drain; grind with minimal ice water to a fluffy, thick batter (a drop floats in water).
Fold in chopped ginger, chilli, curry leaves, cracked pepper, onion and salt.
With wet hands shape 45 g rings; slide into oil at 170 °C; fry 4–5 min until deep golden and crisp.
e124a425.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Serve with Sambar TTK (150 g) and Coconut Chutney TTK (40 g).

5b0eb88b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g cooked chicken
c: Cut chicken into 4 cm pieces; rub with paste, lemon, salt and pepper; rest 30 min.
Blend soaked cashews, cream cheese, cream, yoghurt, cardamom and chilli smooth; coat chicken; marinate 4 h.
Skewer; roast 240 °C 12–15 min (core 75 °C), basting with butter; char lightly under the grill.
Dice vegetables 5 mm; dress with lemon, chaat masala and salt just before service.
5b0eb88b.al: 7 Milk (cream cheese, cream 35%, greek yoghurt 10%, butter) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Contains 8 Nuts (cashew).

25e2674a.yl: Yield: 10 portions (30 pcs) · Portion: 3 pcs ≈ 120 g
c: Slice onions thinly; salt; rest 10 min until they release water.
Add flours, aromatics and spices; add water only to bind into a thick, sticky mix.
Drop loose 40 g heaps into oil at 170 °C; fry 4–5 min until deep golden and crisp; drain.
Blend herbs, chilli, ginger and lemon to a fine paste with 2 tbsp ice water.
Stir into yoghurt with cumin and salt; chill.
25e2674a.st: Best fried to order; re-crisp 180 °C 4 min.

2d055d27.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 skewers) · Portion: 2 skewers ≈ 180 g
c: Toast gram flour dry 1 min; mix with yoghurt, paste, spices, oil, lemon and salt.
Cut paneer, peppers and onion into 3 cm pieces; coat; marinate 1–4 h at 4 °C.
Thread alternately on skewers; grill or roast 240 °C 8–10 min until charred at the edges.
Brush with ghee; sprinkle chaat masala; serve with mint chutney.
Blend herbs, chilli, ginger and lemon to a fine paste with 2 tbsp ice water.
Stir into yoghurt with cumin and salt; chill.
2d055d27.al: 7 Milk (paneer, greek yoghurt 10%, yoghurt 3.6%) · 10 Mustard (mustard oil). Vegetarian.

30cb912e.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 6 puri + 120 g pani
c: Blend herbs, chilli, ginger and tamarind with a little water; strain.
Mix with remaining water, lemon and spices; chill well (it must be ice-cold).
Boil and dice potatoes 5 mm; mix with chickpeas, onion, chaat masala, chilli and coriander.
At service crack each puri on top; fill 1 tsp filling and a little tamarind chutney; dip in pani and eat at once.

b7f6f4da.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 250 g bhaji + 2 pav
c: Boil potatoes, cauliflower, peas and carrots until very soft; drain; mash.
Fry onion in half the butter; add paste, peppers and tomatoes; cook 10 min to a pulp.
Add chilli, masala, turmeric and mashed vegetables; mash together on the flat-top 10 min, adding water to a thick, spreadable curry.
Finish with remaining butter, lemon and coriander.
Split pav; toast on the griddle in butter with a pinch of masala.
Serve bhaji with 2 pav, chopped onion, lime and a knob of butter.
b7f6f4da.al: 1 Gluten (pav buns) · 7 Milk (butter, pav buns). Vegetarian.

0ab74fa0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 vada pav ≈ 190 g
c: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves; add crushed ginger, garlic and chilli, turmeric and mashed potato; salt; coriander; cool.
Shape 10 balls (90 g). Whisk flours, chilli, soda, salt and water to a thick batter.
Dip and fry at 175 °C 3–4 min until golden.
Dry garlic chutney: toast coconut and garlic; pound with chilli and salt.
Split pav; spread green chutney and dry garlic chutney; insert hot vada.
Serve with salted fried green chillies.
0ab74fa0.st: Vada mix: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Fry to order.
0ab74fa0.al: 1 Gluten (pav buns) · 7 Milk (pav buns) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Vegan if pav is dairy-free. Contains 10 Mustard.

59d3575d.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 pcs) · Portion: 2 pcs ≈ 160 g
c: Rub ghee into flour, ajwain and salt until it holds when pressed.
Add cold water; knead to a stiff dough; rest covered 30 min.
Boil potatoes in skins; peel; crumble coarsely.
Crackle cumin in oil; add ginger, chilli, peas and spices; fold in potatoes and coriander; cool.
Roll 10 ovals 2 mm; halve; form cones; fill 50 g; seal with water.
Fry at 150 °C 10–12 min, then 175 °C 2 min until blistered and golden.
Simmer all ingredients 15 min until syrupy.
Blend smooth; pass through a sieve; cool.
59d3575d.st: Raw samosas: −18 °C, 1 month (fry from frozen). Fried: 0–4 °C, 24 h.
59d3575d.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (ghee). Vegan if fried in oil, pastry with oil instead of ghee.

c: Soak chickpeas overnight; cook with soda and tea bag (tied) 1 h until soft; keep 300 g liquid.
Crackle cumin and bay; fry onion 12 min to deep golden; add paste and chilli 2 min.
Add tomato and ground spices; cook to a thick masala 10 min; add chickpeas and liquid; mash a few; simmer 15 min.
Finish with garam masala, amchur, ginger julienne and coriander.
17683484.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Simmer dal with water and turmeric 25 min until soft.
Fry cumin, onion, ginger, chilli and tomato in ghee; add to the dal.
Add chopped spinach; simmer 4 min (keep it green).
Tadka of sliced garlic and chilli powder in ghee; pour over; lemon.
Rinse dals; soak 30 min; simmer with water and turmeric 30–35 min until soft; whisk; salt.
Fry onion, ginger, chilli and tomato in half the ghee 8 min; stir into the dal; simmer 5 min.
Tadka: heat remaining ghee; crackle cumin, sliced garlic until golden, hing and chilli powder; pour over the dal at the pass.
940787f4.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 7 Milk (ghee). Contains 1 Gluten (hing). Vegan with oil instead of ghee.

c: Sauté chopped garlic, ginger and chilli 1 min; add finely diced vegetables 2 min.
Add stock; simmer 6 min; season with pepper and salt.
Thicken lightly with slaked starch; off the heat add lemon and chopped coriander.
1a17a9d7.st: Base: 0–4 °C, 3 days; add lemon and coriander to order.

c: Sweat onion, carrot, apple, garlic and ginger in ghee 10 min; add curry powder and turmeric 1 min.
Add lentils and stock; simmer 25 min; blend smooth.
Poach diced chicken and cooked rice in the soup 8 min; add coconut milk; heat without boiling.
Season with lemon and salt; coriander.
030c29fc.al: 7 Milk (ghee) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 10 Mustard (curry powder). Contains 9 Celery (stock).

83c51551.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 220 g kadhi + 3 pakora
c: Whisk sour yoghurt, gram flour, water, turmeric and chilli smooth.
Crackle seeds, chillies, curry leaves, ginger and hing in ghee; add the mix.
Bring to the boil stirring constantly (prevents splitting); simmer on low 30–40 min until creamy; salt.
Mix sliced onion with flour, spices and water to a thick batter.
Fry small heaps at 170 °C until crisp; add to the kadhi 10 min before service.
83c51551.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, ghee) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Vegetarian. Contains 1 Gluten (hing), 10 Mustard.

c: Soak beans overnight; boil hard 10 min, then simmer 1 h 15 min until creamy; keep the liquid.
Fry cumin, onion, paste and chilli in ghee until golden; add passata and spices; cook 10 min.
Add beans with liquid; mash a few; simmer 20 min to a thick gravy.
Finish with kasuri methi, butter, cream and coriander.
Cook dal with water and turmeric until soft; whisk.
Sambar powder: roast coriander, chana dal, fenugreek, chillies and coconut; grind.
Simmer diced vegetables in tamarind water 12 min; add dal, powder, jaggery and salt; simmer 10 min.
Tadka: mustard seeds, curry leaves and hing in oil; pour over; coriander.
bee3510d.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Vegan. Contains 1 Gluten (hing), 10 Mustard.

c: Cook dal in 500 g water until very soft; whisk smooth.
Coarsely pound pepper, cumin and garlic (rasam powder).
Simmer chopped tomatoes, tamarind, remaining water, turmeric, jaggery and salt 10 min; add the pounded spices and dal; bring just to a froth.
Tadka: crackle mustard seeds, chillies, curry leaves and hing in ghee; pour over; add coriander. Serve hot in cups or over rice.
e9c5795b.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 7 Milk (ghee) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Contains 1 Gluten (hing). Contains 10 Mustard.

5eaf2a5f.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g chicken + 130 g sauce
c: Dry-roast spices and coconut separately until fragrant and golden; cool; grind with a little water to a paste.
Crackle mustard seeds and curry leaves; fry onion until golden; add paste and tomato; cook down.
Add turmeric, chicken and salt; seal 5 min; add masala paste and water; simmer covered 20 min.
Reduce to a thick coating gravy; lime and coriander.
Marinate chicken strips with paste, turmeric, chilli and salt 20 min; sear on high heat; remove.
Crackle cumin; fry onion petals and peppers 3 min, keeping crunch; remove.
Cook chopped tomato, paste and ground spices to a thick masala; return chicken 5 min.
Toss in vegetables and slit chillies 2 min; kasuri methi, lemon and coriander.

abcde034.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 280 g curry + 150 g basmati rice
c: Cut thighs into 4 cm pieces; marinate with all ingredients 4–12 h at 0–4 °C.
Skewer; grill or roast 240 °C convection 12–14 min until charred at the edges; core ≥ 75 °C.
Sweat finely diced onion in butter and oil 12 min until golden; add garlic, ginger and spices 1 min.
Add tomatoes; simmer 15 min; blend smooth; add cream, sugar and crushed methi; simmer 5 min.
Add the grilled tikka; simmer 5 min; finish with coriander.
Rice: rinse, cook covered 12 min with water and 5 g salt; rest 10 min.
abcde034.st: 0–4 °C 3 days; reheat core ≥ 75 °C. Freeze sauce 2 months.

c: Marinate diced chicken in soy, paste and pepper 30 min; coat with egg, starch and flour.
Wok-fry garlic, ginger and chilli; add diced onion and pepper 1 min on high heat.
Add soy-chilli sauce (soy, sriracha, ketchup, vinegar, sugar, water); toss chicken until glazed; spring onion.
95193064.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce). Contains 6 Soy.

222f870d.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 130 g prawns + 120 g sauce
c: Devein prawns; rub with turmeric and salt; sear in smoking mustard oil 1 min per side; remove.
Bloom whole spices in oil and ghee; add grated onion and paste; cook 8 min until golden.
Add chilli, coconut milk, sugar and slit chillies; simmer 8 min.
Return prawns 2–3 min; finish with ghee and garam masala.
222f870d.al: 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 7 Milk (ghee) · 10 Mustard (mustard oil). Contains 2 Crustaceans, 10 Mustard.

1c3aa16b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 140 g fish + 150 g sauce
c: Toast whole spices; blend with coconut, garlic, ginger, tamarind and water to a fine paste.
Cut fish into 5 cm pieces; rub with salt and turmeric 15 min.
Fry onion and slit chillies in coconut oil until soft; add tomato and paste; cook 6 min.
Add coconut milk and water; simmer 5 min; slide in fish; poach 6–8 min without stirring (core 63 °C).
Sharpen with lime (or kokum); coriander. Serve with steamed rice.
1c3aa16b.st: Sauce: 0–4 °C, 3 days. Add fish to order.

8270356f.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g pork + 120 g sauce
c: Soak chillies in the vinegar 30 min.
Toast whole spices; blend everything to a smooth paste.
Marinate diced pork in the paste and salt 12 h at 4 °C.
Fry sliced onion in oil until deep golden; add pork with marinade; sear 10 min.
Add tomato and water; cover; braise 1 h 30 min until tender; reduce; adjust vinegar and salt.
Crackle whole spices; fry onion until golden; add paste and chilli.
Add mince; break up and fry on high heat 10 min until browned.
Add tomato, ground spices and yoghurt; cook covered 20 min.
Add peas 8 min; garam masala, coriander and mint. Serve with pav or naan.

efdb602b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 140 g fish + 150 g sauce
c: Marinate fish pieces with turmeric, pepper, lime and salt 15 min; sear briefly in coconut oil; remove.
Crackle mustard seeds and curry leaves; sweat sliced onion, ginger julienne, garlic and slit chillies until soft (no colour).
Add thin coconut milk; simmer 5 min; add fish and tomato wedges; poach 5 min.
Add thick coconut milk; heat without boiling; season.
efdb602b.al: 4 Fish (hake fillet) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Contains 4 Fish, 10 Mustard.

3f5e6c50.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g lamb + 120 g sauce
c: Soak dried chillies 30 min; blend with garlic to a paste; mix with yoghurt, ground spices and salt; marinate lamb 4 h.
Bloom whole spices in ghee; fry sliced onion until deep brown.
Add lamb with marinade; fry 15 min until the ghee separates; add water; braise covered 1 h 30 min.
Optional dhungar: smoke with a hot coal and ghee in a cup, covered 3 min. Coriander.

8525bd61.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 140 g fish + 160 g curry
c: Rub fish with turmeric and salt; fry in smoking mustard oil 2 min per side; remove.
In the same oil crackle the five seeds (panch phoron); fry potato wedges until golden.
Add onion, ginger, tomato and ground spices; cook 5 min; add water; simmer until potatoes are tender.
Slide in fish and slit chillies; simmer 5 min; coriander. Thin, light gravy.
8525bd61.al: 4 Fish (hake fillet) · 10 Mustard (mustard oil, mustard seeds). Contains 4 Fish, 10 Mustard.

dbd21666.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g chicken + 150 g sauce
c: Marinate diced chicken in yoghurt, paste and salt 1 h.
Fry sliced onion in ghee until golden; blend with soaked cashews and 200 g water to a smooth paste.
Bloom whole spices in ghee; add chicken; seal 5 min; add onion-cashew paste and ground spices; simmer covered 25 min.
Add cream, saffron and rose water; simmer 3 min; garnish with toasted almonds.
dbd21666.al: 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, ghee, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts, almonds). Contains 8 Nuts (cashew, almond).

e5527b67.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g lamb + 120 g sauce
c: Cut lamb into 4 cm pieces; sear in oil and ghee in batches.
Bloom whole spices and hing; add sliced onion; cook until golden.
Whisk yoghurt with chilli, ground fennel and ginger; add off the heat, stirring, to avoid splitting; add tomato paste.
Add lamb and water; cover; braise 1 h 30 min until tender; reduce to a glossy red sauce; garam masala.

b89b181b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g lamb + 140 g saag
c: Sear lamb in oil in batches; bloom whole spices; fry onion until golden; add paste and chilli.
Add tomato and ground spices; cook 8 min; return lamb with water; braise covered 1 h 30 min.
Blanch spinach; blend coarsely; stir into the lamb; simmer 10 min.
Finish with garam masala, ghee and cream.

7e1bbb9e.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 leg ≈ 230 g cooked
c: Skin legs; slash deeply to the bone; rub with lemon, salt and half the chilli; rest 30 min.
Mix yoghurt, paste, spices, oil and remaining chilli; coat; marinate 12–24 h at 4 °C.
Roast on a rack 240 °C 30–35 min (core 75 °C), basting with butter; char under the grill 2 min.
Serve with onion rings, lemon and chaat masala.
7e1bbb9e.al: 7 Milk (greek yoghurt 10%, butter) · 10 Mustard (mustard oil). Contains 10 Mustard.

c: Cut cauliflower into florets and potatoes into 2 cm cubes.
Crackle cumin; fry onion, ginger and chilli 5 min; add tomato and spices.
Add vegetables and salt; toss; cover and cook on low 15 min, then uncover and fry 5 min until tender and lightly charred.
Finish with garam masala, amchur and coriander.
1f1daae9.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Cut vegetables into 5 cm batons; cook with turmeric, salt and little water until just tender.
Grind coconut, chilli and cumin coarsely; add to the vegetables; cook 3 min.
Off the heat fold in whisked yoghurt; finish with raw coconut oil and curry leaves.
Char aubergines directly over a flame or under a hot grill until collapsed and black; rest covered; peel; chop the pulp.
Heat mustard oil to smoking; cool slightly; crackle cumin; fry onion, garlic, ginger and chilli until soft.
Add tomato and spices; cook 8 min; add aubergine; cook 10 min, mashing, until thick.
10e1d629.al: 10 Mustard (mustard oil). Vegan. Gluten-free. Contains 10 Mustard.

c: Wash okra and dry completely (wet okra goes slimy); trim; cut 2 cm.
Fry okra in 2/3 of the oil on high heat 8–10 min until lightly crisp; remove.
Fry cumin, sliced onion, paste and chilli in the rest; add tomato and spices; cook 5 min.
Return okra; toss 3 min; amchur, garam masala, salt.
2d6c6c7e.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

5920f91b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g curry + 150 g rice
c: Sweat diced onion in oil 10 min until golden; add garlic and ginger 2 min.
Add ground spices (toast coriander seeds and grind) 1 min; do not burn.
Add tomatoes; cook 10 min; add coconut milk and chickpeas; simmer 15 min.
Stir in spinach until wilted; finish with lime, salt and coriander.
Rinse; cook covered 12 min; rest 10 min; fluff.
5920f91b.st: 0–4 °C 3 days; freeze curry 2 months; reheat core ≥ 75 °C.

c: Cut paneer, peppers and half the onion into 2.5 cm pieces; stir-fry peppers and onion on high heat 3 min; remove.
Fry remaining chopped onion and paste; add puréed tomato, chilli and turmeric; cook 12 min until the oil separates.
Add kadai masala, peppers and paneer; toss 3 min; finish with kasuri methi, cream, ginger julienne and coriander.
Par-boil potatoes in skins 10 min; peel; prick; deep-fry at 170 °C until golden.
Heat mustard oil to smoking; cool slightly; bloom whole spices and hing.
Whisk yoghurt with chilli, ground fennel and ginger; add off the heat; stir until it boils; add water and potatoes.
Cover tightly; cook on very low heat (dum) 20 min until the gravy coats; garam masala.
bb05eb11.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%) · 10 Mustard (mustard oil). Vegetarian. Contains 1 Gluten (hing), 10 Mustard.

35fdb19c.yl: Yield: 10 portions (30 kofta) · Portion: 3 kofta + 150 g gravy
c: Boil, peel and mash potatoes dry; mix with grated paneer, starch, ginger, chilli, garam masala and salt.
Shape 30 balls, each stuffed with chopped cashew and a raisin.
Fry at 170 °C 3–4 min until golden; drain.
Cook onion, paste, tomato and soaked cashews with water 15 min; blend very smooth; strain.
Bloom cardamom and bay in butter; add the purée, chilli, sugar and salt; simmer 10 min.
Pour hot gravy over kofta at service only (they soften if held in it).
35fdb19c.al: 7 Milk (paneer, butter, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Vegetarian. Contains 8 Nuts (cashew).

c: Crackle cumin and bay; fry onion until golden; add paste and chilli.
Add blended tomato and spices; cook 12 min until the oil separates.
Add water and peas; simmer 6 min; add paneer cubes 3 min.
Blanch diced vegetables separately until just tender; refresh.
Fry onion in ghee until soft (no colour); blend with soaked cashews, yoghurt and water.
Bloom whole spices; add paste and ginger-garlic; simmer 10 min; add coconut milk and cream.
Fold in vegetables, diced paneer, pineapple and raisins; heat 5 min; season.
ea8d6ad1.al: 7 Milk (ghee, yoghurt 3.6%, paneer, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Vegetarian. Contains 8 Nuts (cashew).

2fec40aa.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 120 g paneer + 130 g sauce
c: Simmer tomatoes, soaked cashews, paste, whole spices and water 20 min; remove whole spices; blend silky; strain.
Melt butter; add purée, chilli, sugar and salt; simmer 10 min until glossy.
Add cubed paneer (soaked in hot water 10 min); simmer 3 min; finish with cream, kasuri methi and garam masala.
2fec40aa.al: 7 Milk (paneer, butter, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Vegetarian. Gluten-free. Contains 8 Nuts (cashew).

c: Knead to a soft dough; rest 30 min.
Mash dry potatoes with finely chopped onion, chilli, ginger, coriander, spices and salt.
Roll 75 g dough to Ø 10 cm; wrap 90 g filling; seal; roll gently to Ø 20 cm.
Cook on a hot tawa 1 min per side; brush with ghee; fry until golden spots.
Knead atta, salt, water and oil 8 min to a soft dough; rest covered 30 min.
Divide 38 g; roll thinly Ø 16 cm with a little dry flour.
Cook on a hot tawa 30 s per side until spotted; puff directly over the flame.
Brush with ghee; stack in a cloth-lined container.
a149aa55.al: 1 Gluten (wholemeal flour) · 7 Milk (ghee). Vegan without ghee.

c: Marinate diced chicken with yoghurt, spices, ginger, garlic and salt 2 h.
Fry thinly sliced onion in clarified butter until deep golden (birista); keep half for garnish.
Cook chicken with the remaining onions 15 min until thick (core ≥ 75 °C); add herbs.
Soak rice 30 min; boil in salted water with whole spices 6 min (70% cooked); drain.
Layer in GN: chicken masala, rice, saffron milk, fried onions, herbs; seal with foil and lid.
Dum-cook 160 °C 25 min; rest 10 min; fluff gently. Serve with raita (see TTK\_Cucumber\_Raita).
Cook rice; spread to cool so grains stay separate.
Crackle mustard seeds; fry dals and peanuts until golden; add curry leaves, chillies, ginger, turmeric and hing.
Off the heat add lemon juice and salt; fold through the rice; coriander.
18e7c2d1.st: 0–4 °C, 24 h; serve warm or room temperature.
18e7c2d1.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 5 Peanuts (peanuts) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Vegan. Contains 1 Gluten (hing), 5 Peanuts, 10 Mustard.

c: Cut lamb into 6 cm pieces; mix with all ingredients; marinate 12 h at 4 °C.
Fry thinly sliced onions at 160 °C until deep golden (birista); crush half into the marinade.
Spread lamb in a heavy handi with 50 g ghee. Boil rice with whole spices and salt to 70% cooked (5 min); drain; layer over the lamb.
Top with saffron milk, kewra, rose water, remaining birista, ghee and herbs; seal the lid with dough.
Cook on high 10 min, then very low on a tawa 50–60 min (lamb core ≥ 75 °C). Rest 10 min; open at the table.
447251a0.st: Serve at once; cool fast; 0–4 °C, 24 h.

c: Rice 500 g + dal 170 g dry → ≈ 1500 g batter
Soak rice and dal (with fenugreek) separately 6 h; grind dal fluffy, rice slightly coarse; mix; salt.
Fill oiled idli moulds 3/4; steam 10–12 min until a skewer comes out clean; rest 2 min; unmould.
a35b8fb2.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Serve with Sambar TTK (150 g) and Coconut Chutney TTK (40 g).

c: Rinse rice until clear; soak 30 min; drain.
Crackle cumin, bay and cardamom in ghee; add rice; toss 1 min.
Add boiling salted water; cover; cook on low 12 min; rest off the heat 10 min; fluff; coriander.
fc079277.st: Hot hold 65 °C, 2 h. Cool fast; 0–4 °C, 24 h.

c: Knead flours, salt, sugar, milk, water and 20 g ghee to a soft dough; rest 30 min.
Roll 100 g balls very thin; brush with ghee; dust with flour; pleat like a fan; coil into a spiral; rest 15 min.
Roll gently to Ø 18 cm; cook on a hot tawa with ghee 2 min per side until crisp and golden.
Crush between palms to open the layers.
ba8d08f2.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, wholemeal flour) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, ghee). Vegetarian.

ee83e499.yl: Yield: 10 dosa · Portion: 1 dosa + 120 g masala
c: Rice 400 g + dal 130 g dry → ≈ 1300 g batter
Soak rice with fenugreek, and dal separately, 6 h; grind each smooth with water; mix; salt.
Ferment 10–14 h at 28–32 °C until doubled and bubbly.
Spread 120 g in a thin spiral on a hot tawa; drizzle ghee; cook until golden and crisp; fill and fold.
Crackle mustard seeds, chana dal and curry leaves; sweat sliced onion, ginger and chilli.
Add turmeric, potato, salt and water; mix to a soft masala; coriander.

c: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt and baking powder; add warm yoghurt, milk, water and oil; knead 8 min to a soft dough; rise 1 h 30 min.
Divide 100 g; rest 10 min; stretch into teardrops 5 mm; sprinkle nigella.
Cook on a very hot pizza stone/oven 280 °C 3–4 min, or in a hot cast-iron pan and finish over the flame, until puffed and blistered.
Brush with butter (garlic and coriander for garlic naan).

Roll 20 g balls into Ø 10 cm discs, 2 mm, using oil (not flour).
Fry at 190 °C, pressing gently with a slotted spoon until they puff; turn; 20 s; drain.
Fry half the onion until golden (birista); fry rest until soft; add paste, chilli and tomato.
Add yoghurt and spices; add diced vegetables; cook covered 10 min until 3/4 tender; add paneer and herbs.
Boil rice with whole spices to 75% cooked; drain.
Layer masala and rice in a buttered handi; top with saffron milk, kewra, ghee and birista.
Seal; dum on very low heat 25 min; rest 10 min; fluff gently.

Add rice, boiling water and salt; cover tightly; cook on low 12 min; rest 10 min; fluff with mint.
Dissolve sugar in vinegar; add mango, grated ginger, garlic, spices and salt.
Simmer 40–50 min, stirring, until thick and glossy (103 °C).
Pot into sterilised jars hot; seal.
6b110913.st: Sealed jars: ambient, 6 months; opened 0–4 °C, 1 month.

Store airtight, dark; label with date.

949b876a.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

8429cd18.al: 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Vegan. Gluten-free. Contains 10 Mustard.
